liebermann.notes: Pontifical of the province of Canterbury, perhaps from the diocese of Ely (Æthelthryth is written large in the litany); related to Tb. Contains Iudicium Dei XI (f. 14) and XII (f. 78v), the latter most closely related to Bc.

entries.text_de: Cambridge University Ll II 102, 12. Jh., Pontifical der Provinz Canterbury und, da in der Litanei Ætheldrytha gross steht, vielleicht aus Sprengel Ely; verwandt mit Tb. F. 14 Iud Dei XI, u. S. 419; f. 78b Iud Dei XII, u. S. 420, nächst verwandt mit Bc.
entries.text_en: Cambridge University Ll II 102, 12th century, pontifical of the province of Canterbury and, since Ætheldrytha stands in capitals in the litany, perhaps from the diocese of Ely; related to Tb. F. 14 Iud Dei XI, below, p. 419; f. 78b Iud Dei XII, below, p. 420, most closely related to Bc.
